description: This file defines the EmployeeSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and provides parameters for filtering employee search results within the OrangeHRM PIM module. It includes properties for various search criteria (like employee name, ID, status, subunit, supervisor, location) and validation logic for some parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class for defining search parameters for employee filtering, including allowed sort fields, inclusion options for current/past employees, and various getter/setter methods with validation.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Retrieves the includeEmployees property, which determines whether to include current, past, or both types of employees.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the includeEmployees property, validating against allowed options defined in INCLUDE_EMPLOYEES_MAP.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the name filter parameter.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name filter parameter.

methods.name: getNameOrId
methods.description: Retrieves the name or ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setNameOrId
methods.description: Sets the name or ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Gets the list of employee numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of employee numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Gets the employee ID filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID filter parameter.

methods.name: getEmpStatusId
methods.description: Gets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: setEmpStatusId
methods.description: Sets the employment status ID filter.

methods.name: getJobTitleId
methods.description: Gets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: setJobTitleId
methods.description: Sets the job title ID filter.

methods.name: getSubunitId
methods.description: Retrieves the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: setSubunitId
methods.description: Sets the subunit ID filter.

methods.name: getSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Gets the list of supervisor employee numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: setSupervisorEmpNumbers
methods.description: Sets the list of supervisor employee numbers used as a filter.

methods.name: getLocationId
methods.description: Gets the location ID filter.

methods.name: setLocationId
methods.description: Sets the location ID filter.
